receipts.statement: 61 human link clicks on jov.ie/tim in 90 days
receipts.reproducingQuery: select count(*) from click_events ce join creator_profiles cp on cp.id = ce.creator_profile_id where cp.username_normalized = 'tim' and ce.is_bot = false and ce.created_at >= now() - interval '90 days' and (ce.ip_address is null or ce.ip_address not in (select s.ip_address from ba_sessions s where s.ip_address is not null and s.user_id in (select u.better_auth_user_id from users u where u.is_admin or split_part(lower(u.email), '@', 2) in ('jov.ie', 'timwhite.co'))))
receipts.population: jov.ie/tim, is_bot=false, 90 days ending measuredAt; excludes IPs used by Jovie staff sessions

receipts.reproducingQuery: select count(*) from audience_members am join creator_profiles cp on cp.id = am.creator_profile_id where cp.username_normalized = 'tim' and am.type = 'email' and coalesce(split_part(lower(am.email), '@', 2), '') not in ('jov.ie', 'timwhite.co') and coalesce(lower(am.email), '') not in (select lower(u.email) from users u where u.is_admin or split_part(lower(u.email), '@', 2) in ('jov.ie', 'timwhite.co'))
receipts.population: jov.ie/tim audience members identified by email; excludes anonymous visitors and Jovie staff emails
